Class ExecutorSpigot

java.lang.Object
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.spigot.util.implementations.ExecutorSpigot
All Implemented Interfaces:
IDebuggable, IExecutor, IRestartable
@Singleton public final class ExecutorSpigot extends Object implements IExecutor, IRestartable, IDebuggable
Implementation of IExecutor for the Spigot platform.

  • Method Details

    • getVirtualExecutor

      public ExecutorService getVirtualExecutor()
      Description copied from interface: IExecutor
      A virtual executor that creates a new virtual thread for each task.

      This should be used for all tasks that spend a lot of time waiting (e.g. I/O operations).

      This executor will be shut down and replaced when the plugin restarts. This means that all tasks that are still running when the plugin restarts will be cancelled. If this is not desired, a custom executor should be created.

      Specified by:
      getVirtualExecutor in interface IExecutor
      Returns:
      The virtual executor.
